{{Quote|This is a living planet, one large organism, more than the sum of its parts.|[[Nom Anor]] in disguise as [[Nom Anor|Yu'shaa]]|<ref name="TFP">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''</ref>}}
'''Zonama Sekot''' ([[Ferroan language|Ferroan]] for "'''World of Body and Mind'''") and labelled by [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] surveys as '''M-Eighteen''', was a [[Sentience/Legends|living]] rogue [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. ''Zonama'' was the planet itself, while ''Sekot'' was the living organism. It became the adopted [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] after the [[Sekot accords|end]] of their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war of conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. 

Zonama Sekot was born from a seed of [[Yuuzhan'tar]], the original living sentient homeworld of the Yuuzhan Vong which had been destroyed during the [[Cremlevian War|eons of conflict]] in a [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|distant galaxy]]. Zonama Sekot was once in the [[Tingel Arm/Legends|Tingel Arm]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] before disappearing into the Unknown Regions. 

==Description==
[[File:Vergere-vongmeet.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Vergere surrenders to the Yuuzhan Vong on Zonama Sekot's surface]]
Zonama Sekot was unique from other [[Planet/Legends|worlds]]. Its north polar region, a spot of pearl white was surrounded by an entire hemisphere of tropical jungles. Its southern hemisphere was covered with impenetrable silvery clouds. Along the equator there were several [[Water/Legends|rivers]], lakes, and small seas. The edge of the southern hemisphere was also covered by elegant wisps of wind which frequently broke free to form spinning storms.<ref name="RP" />

==History==
{{Quote|From what I have seen, peace does not seem to be the natural state of the universe.|Sekot|<ref name="Force Heretic III">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion]]''</ref>}}
Zonama Sekot was the seed of the original [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Yuuzhan'tar]], which had been destroyed during the [[Cremlevian War]].<ref name="DJ">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref><ref name="TUF" />

Zonama Sekot's first settlers were black-haired humanoid [[Ferroan]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] and red-skinned [[Langhesi]] colonists, and the living world was ruled by [[Magister]]s. The Ferroans were believers in the [[Potentium]] view of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The Langhesi and Ferroans settled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in [[89 BBY]].

During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Zonama Sekot was rumored to be home to the fastest ships in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], traveled there to find fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Vergere]] and to purchase one of the planet's [[Jabitha|living ships]]. Anakin bonded with a record twelve [[seed-partner]]s, Obi-Wan bonded with an additional three. While Zonama Sekot was under [[First Battle of Zonama Sekot|attack]] from the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] ([[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]&ndash;[[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]]), it was able to defeat them. Later [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], then a Republic [[Lieutenant governor/Legends|political leader]] and [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|security force]] commander, declared war on the living world and [[Second Battle of Zonama Sekot|attacked]] it in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. Zonama Sekot unveiled its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] system, which had been built by the Langhesi, and escaped into the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="RP" />

[[File:Zonama_Sekot_20_BBY.jpg|thumb|left|270px|Zonama Sekot's last known position by [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]]]
In the following [[Standard year/Legends|years]], stories of the "rogue planet" that had once made living ships circulated among many in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].

Many years later during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and several other Jedi traveled to Zonama Sekot, which harbored the long forgotten secrets of the galaxy's invaders. Recognizing a glimmer of Anakin Skywalker in Luke and Jacen, Sekot allowed them to land and tested them. Sekot offered to destroy the Yuuzhan Vong entirely, but both Luke and Jacen refused. Nevertheless, Sekot decided to help them, in another way. Later, [[Nom Anor]], disguised as [[Nom Anor|Yu'shaa]], the leader of the underground ''Jeedai'' heretics, tried without success to destroy the living world.

Zonama Sekot traveled to Yuuzhan Vong-held [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], which had been renamed Yuuzhan'tar, and forged a [[Sekot accords|peace]] between the Yuuzhan Vong and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]]. Converted and surrendered Yuuzhan Vong came to call Zonama home, and a number of communities were established. One such village was [[La'okio]], created as an experiment to break down the walls dividing the Yuuzhan Vong castes by grouping the beings into mixed groups.

[[Reh'mwa]], a leader of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[ar'krai]] against the Yuuzhan Vong, provisioned the ''[[Avengeance]]'' for searching for Zonama Sekot in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. After the end of the war, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] held a [[Conclave on Zonama Sekot|meeting]] on the planet to explain the role of the Jedi in the post-war galaxy.

At the start of the [[Sith–Imperial War]], it retreated further into the Unknown Regions, stranding the Yuuzhan Vong who remained in the galaxy as part of the [[Ossus Project]]. By [[137 ABY]], it was situated at a location<ref name="TEA" /> that, shortly after the acquisition of the planet [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], had been featured on a [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the original outline of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic III: Reunion]]'', Zonama Sekot was going to have a young, sentient moon termed "Zonama X", which would have convinced its parent world to join the war against the Yuuzhan Vong.<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>
